The Early Blight reference showed the closest visual match — widespread brown necrotic areas interspersed with yellow tissue across multiple leaves in a similar pattern. While classic Early Blight shows concentric-ring target spots, in advanced coalescent stages the individual lesions merge into large brown regions with surrounding chlorosis, consistent with what's visible in the test image. Verticillium Wilt remains a secondary candidate given the veinal browning pattern, but the overall leaf necrosis pattern best fits Early Blight.
